_rule: owner, 2026-11-22: a new species enemy has artwork for every function before it is wired (docs/SPECIES_MOVESET.md). tests/species-moveset.cjs holds every species with rule:true.
_audit: the older species (rule:false) were audited once, 2026-11-22, from their art tables: what each lacks against the template. Not held by the harness; the owner decides whether they are re-fired.

idle.drawn: floating still in the water (sub, dorm)

walk.drawn: backing off on land, the high walk run backwards, paced by distance

run.drawn: phase two: running head first for the water

turn.drawn: phase two: turning round through the front before he runs

notice.drawn: the fight's first beat: head up, hiss

crouch.drawn: the coil at the surface, the last 45% of the bite's warning

attack.drawn: the jaws slamming in the leap; the tail slam

jump.drawn: the leap out of the water

land.drawn: the first beat of a beaching

defend.drawn: the threat gape while beached or spent: his open jaws are the weak point

dead.drawn: the last cell of the collapse, sinking

signature.drawn: the death roll (the first roll take, a twist, refused)

swim.drawn: every stroke paced by distance: under water, rising on the slant, backing into the water

roar.drawn: the bellow that opens phase two

alpha.audit: assets/characters/alpha (rest, prowl, roar, howl, leap, air, claw, bite, clinch, yield)

gravehorn.audit: a parts rig with fired plates (js/gravehorn.js): poses, not takes — audited separately
